costs: CFD: BTC/ETH 5 bp, altcoins 10 bp per side, swap 3.3 bp per rollover

tests.P1 Coinbase premium on the 9 CFD altcoin: Gen88 Q1 rule unchanged per coin (premium = Coinbase USD close / Binance perp close - 1; 24h mean; 30-day z; z > 1 long, z < -1 short, 1 day), 0.5 per coin, as a separate sleeve next to the BTC/ETH premium
tests.P2 Korean premium momentum (PRIMARY): kimchi premium = Upbit KRW close / USDKRW (Yahoo daily close of the previous day) / Binance perp close - 1, daily value at the 23:00 UTC bar; 30-day z of the daily value; z > 1 long, z < -1 short, 1 day, BTC/ETH 0.5 each
